backend/main.mo: Handles storing inquiries with validation and provides a query to retrieve all inquiries.
feature_evidence.json: Defines feature evidence entries mapping features to affected frontend files and metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Lists short summaries of all frontend project files for reference.
frontend/index.css: Sets global Tailwind base variables and dark mode tokens for color, layout, and component styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading fonts and mounting the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Configures TanStack Router with all site routes wrapped in SiteLayout.
frontend/src/components/CategoryHierarch: Displays subcategories in a grid and navigates to subcategory pages on click.
frontend/src/components/ProductQuickView: Renders a glass‑styled modal showing product details with an inquiry action.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Footer with company info, quick links, contact details, and caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Responsive site header with scroll effects, navigation links, and mobile menu toggle.
frontend/src/components/SiteLayout.tsx: Layout wrapper rendering header, footer, and routed page content via Outlet.
Card component generating product descriptions and placeholder images for subcategories.
frontend/src/data/productTaxonomy.ts: Static product category taxonomy defining categories, subcategories, and product types.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages a backend actor instance based on the user's identity.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider handling Internet Identity auth state, login flow, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query mutation hook for submitting inquiries via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and custom theme variables for colors, typography, and component styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry mounting React with query client and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders an About page with company background, mission, and differentiators using static text sections.
frontend/src/pages/CataloguePage.tsx: Displays catalogue request information and features, with a CTA that navigates to a prefilled contact form.
frontend/src/pages/CategoryPage.tsx: Shows a product category with banner, customization note, subcategories, and handles invalid categories and inquiry navigation.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Implements a contact form with validation, category prefilling, submission handling, and a success state.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with a hero section, company introduction, and feature highlights, plus navigation buttons.
frontend/src/pages/ProductsPage.tsx: Lists all product categories in a grid and links each to its corresponding category page.
frontend/src/pages/SubcategoryPage.tsx: Renders a subcategory page with banner, product grid, inquiry CTA, and product quick‑view modal driven by URL slugs. Handles missing categories, navigation, and modal state.
frontend/src/utils/slug.ts: Provides utilities to convert text to URL‑friendly slugs and back to capitalized words.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme extensions, colors, typography, container settings, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Describes current project state, visual direction, requirements, and known features for a luxury editorial site redesign.
